name: csharp-lsp-abi
instructions: These tools talk to a running C# language server rooted at the session's working directory, and answer only for C# source files. Positions are 1-based (line 1 is the first line, character 1 is the first column of that line), matching how a human reads a file — the plugin converts to the server's own convention internally. csharp_definition and csharp_references need a file path (relative to the working directory or absolute) plus a line and character landing inside the symbol. csharp_diagnostics takes only a file path and reports whatever the server currently has computed for it; call csharp_definition or csharp_references first if diagnostics come back empty right after a file is opened, since the server needs a moment to analyse it.

tools.name: csharp_definition
tools.description: Finds where the symbol at a file position is DECLARED. Crosses project boundaries: a reference in a test project resolves to a declaration in the project under test, if the server has indexed both.

file.description: Path to the file, relative to the working directory or absolute.

character.description: 1-based column, landing inside the symbol's name.

tools.name: csharp_references
tools.description: Finds every place the symbol at a file position is USED, across every project the server has indexed.

file.description: Path to the file, relative to the working directory or absolute.

character.description: 1-based column, landing inside the symbol's name.

tools.name: csharp_diagnostics
tools.description: Reports the server's current errors and warnings for a file — whatever it has already computed, not a fresh compile on demand.

file.description: Path to the file, relative to the working directory or absolute.
